spans.label: DepositStepTarget::new: range-checked allocations, conditional cyclic verification and vd connect, is_initial selects, index/block connects, Merkle verify + re-root, range-checked increment, keccak fold, new_pis
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement. CircuitGates is the local gate system for ARBITRARY satisfying witnesses, stated in source order and deliberately separate from the native path. It records that the previous proof is conditionally verified under the verifier data declared in THAT PROOF'S OWN public inputs, that deposit_index is connected to the selected previous count unconditionally (both branches), that the block number is connected only on a continued step, and that add_const + range_check(63) cannot wrap in Goldilocks. Chain iterates these gates under the proof-soundness premise; chain_matches_rollup_fold compares the resulting chain value with RollupValue's finishDeposit fold under the named keccak bridges.

boundaries.name: plonky2_refinement
boundaries.obligation: The handwritten gate equations (CircuitGates, WrapGates), the builder/prover/verifier programs and the registered public-input vector must be linked to actual plonky2 compilation, proving and verification; none of that lowering is discharged here.

boundaries.name: hash_opacity
boundaries.obligation: Environment.keccakWords (plonky2_keccak solidity_keccak256 over u32 words), poseidonWords (PoseidonHashOut::hash_inputs_u64) and twoToOne (the Poseidon 2-to-1 of the incremental deposit tree) are opaque callbacks. No collision resistance, preimage resistance or injectivity is assumed or proved, so equal accumulator values never imply equal deposit sequences.

boundaries.name: proof_soundness
boundaries.obligation: Environment.proofAccepted vd pis is an opaque Bool. 'accepted implies produced by a gate-satisfying witness' is encoded as the Chain inductive premise, never proved; plonky2/FRI soundness is out of scope.

boundaries.name: consumer_vd_pin
boundaries.obligation: On the initial step new_pis.vd is a free virtual verifier data (theorem initial_step_vd_unconstrained) and every continued step forwards it unchanged (chain_declares_single_vd). Only a consumer pins it to the real chain verifier data: DepositHashChainCircuit::verify -> check_cyclic_proof_verifier_data (modeled as chain_verify_pins_declared_vd) or block_step.rs add_proof_target_and_conditionally_verify_cyclic, which is outside the modeled files and must be audited there.

boundaries.name: field_and_gadget_lowering
boundaries.obligation: Goldilocks arithmetic, split_le, range_check, select, the keccak and Poseidon gadgets, DepositMerkleProofTarget and from_pis slicing are modeled as Nat equations over lists. Their circuit lowering, and in particular that split_le(prev_count, 63) is what bounds the previous count below 2^63, is assumed.

boundaries.name: solidity_keccak_packing
boundaries.obligation: SolidityKeccakPacking: plonky2_keccak solidity_keccak256 must consume each u32 word as four big-endian bytes (wordsToBytes). Under that packing fold_preimage_matches_rollup_model is kernel-checked; equality of the chain VALUES additionally needs KeccakBridge and RollupValue.HashEncodingAgrees (the same keccak on both sides) and KeccakOutputsChecked (32-bit gadget output limbs).

boundaries.name: initial_state_pin
boundaries.obligation: The initial hash chain, tree root and count of a chain proof are free inputs of the initial step. That they equal IntmaxRollup's actual pendingDepositChain / deposit tree / depositCount is pinned in block_step.rs, and L1 finality of the deposits is outside every modeled file.

boundaries.name: vd_canonicity
boundaries.obligation: vd_from_pis_slice / vd_from_pis_slice_target read verifier-data field elements from u64 public inputs with no canonicity check; verifier-data words are carried as an opaque List Nat and compared only for equality.

boundaries.name: native_merkle_height
boundaries.obligation: Native DepositMerkleProof::verify uses siblings.len() as the tree height (theorem native_accepts_short_sibling_list), so a short sibling list is accepted on the native path. The 63-sibling shape is enforced only by DepositMerkleProofTarget::new (CircuitGates.siblingsHeight) and by the set_witness length assertion inside the imported gadget, neither of which is proved here.

boundaries.name: native_proof_not_checked
boundaries.obligation: to_public_inputs never verifies the supplied prev_deposit_chain_proof; it only parses its public inputs, and an invalid proof is rejected later inside plonky2 prove. This is the hproof premise of native_assignment_satisfies_gates and is not discharged.

boundaries.name: deposit_leaf_encoding
boundaries.obligation: Deposit::to_u64_vec (Poseidon leaf / nullifier preimage, 32 u64 words including deposit_index and block_number) and Deposit::hash_with_prev_hash (keccak fold preimage, 38 u32 words WITHOUT index or block) live in common::deposit and are re-declared here by hand; their agreement with the real Rust encodings is assumed.

boundaries.name: no_deposit_uniqueness
boundaries.obligation: Nothing in this file prevents the same L1 deposit being appended twice at different indices, or an invented deposit being appended: the model only shows that whatever deposits a chain proof appended form a consecutive-index, single-block-number trace. Correspondence with real L1 deposits is InitialStatePin plus the on-chain deposit tree.
